product.name: Advertising and Communications
product.description: Provides creative solutions to address clients' business problems through consistent messaging across various channels including websites, ads, and social media.

product.name: AI-Enhanced Creative Process
product.description: Integrates artificial intelligence with human creativity to identify and apply insights for impactful and distinctive ideas.

product.name: Production Services
product.description: Delivers creative and strategic content production using technology to ensure operational precision, cost control, and timely execution.

product.name: Design Services
product.description: Applies design thinking and craftsmanship to develop visual identities, product designs, communication strategies, and experience designs.

product.name: Global-to-Local Integrated Agency Model
product.description: Offers integrated creative services through a global network with local market agility, combining resources from a large parent company with nimble execution.
